details.question: 每一年的消费金额最高的客户 ID 分别是？
details.golden_sql: SELECT y, CustomerId, s FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS y, CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS s, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC) AS rk FROM invoices GROUP BY y, CustomerId) WHERE rk = 1

FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY Year, c.CustomerId
HAVING TotalSpent = (
    SELECT MAX(TotalSpent)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(i2.Total) AS TotalSpent
        FROM invoices i2
        WHERE strftime('%Y', i2.InvoiceDate) = Year
        GROUP BY i2.CustomerId
    )
)
ORDER BY Year;
